Plan the next biweekly ABAP developer COE session using the structure in sap-technical-assets/templates/km-session-template.md.

If I haven't given you a topic, propose 3 candidates: one current S/4HANA/BTP innovation, one recurring code-review/architecture pain point, one AI-driven ABAP development topic (Copilot patterns, AI-assisted review, Joule for developers). Give a one-line pitch, timeliness, and effort (S/M/L) for each.

Once a topic is set, produce:
- Specific, checkable learning objectives
- A concrete, runnable demo plan (not slides-only)
- Discussion questions tied to our actual project work
- A one-page cheat-sheet takeaway section

Don't draft version-specific claims (release names, feature availability) from memory alone — flag anything that needs verifying against current SAP docs before the session.
